_guide: Harness tests run on the server in Studio (src/server/CarTest/Scenarios.luau). Trigger: play, then ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("CarTestRun", true). Output: [CARTEST] {json} lines and [CARTEST] END pass=N fail=N.
UI tests run on the client (src/client/UiTest/). Trigger: set ReplicatedStorage attribute UiTestRun false then true on the server during play. Output: [UITEST] ... END pass=N fail=N.
Limits live in src/shared/PhysicsTargets.luau. They are feel decisions for the owner: never change them to make a test pass.
Only test-writer / ui-test-writer edit tests. The loop is: write the test (red), implement, audit the tests were not loosened, run the FULL suite, repeat until fail=0.
Pushing to main needs /compat-check ALL GREEN: harness + ui + multiplayer + world + the final regression pass, for exactly the code being pushed (tools/compat.py).

static_settle.checks: A parked car settles and stays still. Four fresh drops (new car each, dropped 0, 0.25, 0.5 and 1 stud above the spawn pose): after 3 s each one is checked for speed, suspension compression and level body (worst of the four), then watched every frame for 6 s more: peak speed, peak vertical speed and peak-to-peak chassis height. The last drop's hold adds a 20 ms server stall every 0.5 s, like a busy cold start, and is reported separately as hitch_*.
static_settle.why: A single sample at 3 s caught the at-rest vertical jitter (~0.8 studs/s suspension kicks) only about 1 run in 3. Watching the whole hold window over several drops makes a jittering car fail every run, and a green run means the jitter is really gone. If the car jitters or sinks at rest, every other physics result is unreliable.
static_settle.limits: PhysicsTargets.static_settle: MaxSettleSpeed 0.5 studs/s (at 3 s and peak over the hold), compression 0.15-0.65, MaxTiltDeg 3, MaxRestVerticalSpeed 0.3 studs/s peak |vy|, MaxRestBobStuds 0.03 peak-to-peak Y

accel.checks: From standstill the car reaches 40 studs/s fast enough, gets near TopSpeed, and drives straight.
accel.why: Feel of the car and the base for the race speeds.

brake.checks: From 60 studs/s the car stops within the distance and does not swerve.
brake.why: PathDriver slows for corners by braking; bad brakes mean overshoot and off-track.

skidpad.checks: At 40 studs/s and full steer the car turns tightly enough and stays upright.
skidpad.why: Corner grip decides the safe corner speed in the auto race.

car_size.checks: The car is about half its original 13.2 stud length, with body, wheels and suspension scaled together.
car_size.why: The half-size car is a design decision; this stops it drifting back.

chain.checks: Tracks joined finish-to-start in Number order connect smoothly and never overlap each other.
chain.why: Track rule 3: the finish of track N is the start of N+1.

money.checks: MoneyService contract: pad payouts are decided by the server, paid once per pass, with a per-player cooldown, and bad awards are rejected.
money.why: Money is the economy; clients must never be able to pay themselves.

race.checks: The real chain is auto-raced by RaceService at the Speed stat's cruise speed: stays on its path, never flips or tilts, pads pay once, the stat grows, also at MAX_STAT speed. race_rail_never_snaps / max_speed_rail_never_snaps: from start to the last checkpoint the rail never teleports the car (run.RailSnaps, frames where the rail fell back to PivotTo; missing counts as a fail).
race.why: This is the core loop of the game. A server PivotTo every frame replicates to the client as a stutter (the car moves 3.7, 0, 3.7, 0 studs on alternate frames at speed 111, measured 2026-10-15); steering by velocity moves it smoothly every frame.
race.limits: race: MaxPathDeviation 5, MinUpY 0.9, MaxFlips 0; lap.MinUpYStrict 0.9; race.MaxRailSnaps 0

flip_recovery.checks: A car put upside down mid-race is set upright back on the path in time and keeps racing. Fall guard (owner 2026-10-20): a racing car moved 30 studs below the road or 40 above it is back on the path within race.RailFallRecoverySeconds, never drops below the map and keeps racing upright; the fastest catalog car (2800x) at stat 200 x HALF_STAT (owner 2026-10-21: cruise = SpeedFor(stat x 2800), the shown Speed, faster than the MAX_STAT race) drives the whole track within race.MaxPathDeviation, upright, never below the map.
flip_recovery.why: Safety net: a stuck car would end the idle loop, and fast cars used to fall out of the map.

economy.checks: RaceConfig maths: SpeedFor rises from BASE_SPEED towards MAX_SPEED with diminishing returns; GainPerSecond is GAIN_PER_STUD x actual speed at every stat (owner 2026-10-13: the stat never reduces it, GAIN_SOFT removed), so the gain at cruise speed rises with the stat; every doubling of a high stat adds (MAX_SPEED - BASE_SPEED) / 2 studs/s of cruise speed. Owner 2026-10-20 constants (much harsher progression): BASE_SPEED 12, MAX_SPEED 22, HALF_STAT 5000, GAIN_PER_STUD 0.01, MAX_STAT 1e9. Owner 2026-10-21 (multiplied Speed): SpeedFor(stat, m) = SpeedFor(stat x m) (full multi on the stat, no damping, same shown Speed gives the same cruise speed; at stat 0 no multi adds speed; below 1 it slows the car; bad / <= 0 / inf multis count as 1; stat x m past a double stays finite). StatFor(speed) inverts SpeedFor both ways, is 0 at or below BASE_SPEED and inf past a double. MAX_SPEED 22 (owner 2026-10-21, lower track requirements).
economy.why: Balancing numbers in one place, tested as pure functions.

data.checks: PlayerData saves and loads Money, Speed, cars, rolls, stat allocation, upgrade tiles, BestTrack, TurboCount and WorkshopLevel through a stub store; never writes before the load finished; old save formats (v1-v3) still load (v3: TurboCount = Rolls % 10, BestTrack 0, WorkshopLevel 1). Owner 2026-10-21: the base Speed is player.BaseSpeed (saved, loaded, AddSpeed); leaderstats.Speed is display only = BaseSpeed x ShownSpeedMulti after AddSpeed and Equip, a write to it never changes the stat, and the save payload Speed is the base.
data.why: Lost or overwritten saves are the worst bug a game can ship.
data.limits: PlayerData VERSION 4 rules; WorkshopLevel clamped to 1..WorkshopConfig.MAX_LEVEL

hud.checks: HudFormat: the Speed / Money numbers are formatted correctly and the count-up smoothing behaves. Owner 2026-10-21: SpeedText shows full digits below HudFormat.SUFFIX_FROM (placeholder 1e15) and HudFormat.Short from it on (K M B T Qd Qt Sx Sp Oc No Dc, 3 significant digits, 999.96K rolls to 1M, past Dc scientific, inf -> "inf", bad input "0").
hud.why: The HUD must show the server's truth, readable at any size.

auto_toggle.checks: Stop Auto / Auto Race: stopping returns the avatar on foot to the spawn area, resuming starts at the start line, the Speed stat is kept, rapid toggles and bad input are safe, hidden avatars never collide.
auto_toggle.why: The most-clicked control; swapping in and out must never bug the car.

spawn_area.checks: The purple spawn floor (228 x 232, with the old 160 x 144 area as the hub) is the only SpawnLocation, sits right of Track 1's start, the spawn is at the hub centre, edges only on the outer sides, never overlaps a track; walking on the StartPad starts racing with a cooldown.

gacha.checks: Car catalog and config, seeded roll odds (rarest first, min(1, luck/Chance)), turbo every 10th roll, owning = discovering, the auto-roll timer.
gacha.why: The odds are the game's promise to players; they must match what is shown.

index.checks: Discoveries give stat points, allocation is validated, equip works, and the multipliers change Speed gain and pad pay but never physics. Owner 2026-10-21: the ShownSpeedMulti attribute is the equipped car's SpeedMulti x the aura's and follows Equip and EquippedAura.
index.why: Progression maths and anti-cheat on AllocateStat / EquipCar.

npc.checks: Each track's NPC drives the left lane as pure maths and is faster than a stat-0 car even on Track 1; it wears a catalog car skin and a NPC RIVAL label; win if you finish before it, lose plays out then resets to Track 1; a loss empties the bank. Owner 2026-10-21 (lower track requirements): Track 1 = NpcConfig.BASE_SPEED, growth = NpcConfig.SPEED_GROWTH (read live), Track 1's recommended Speed (StatFor) below 10,000.
npc.why: The race against the NPC is the game's challenge.

bank.checks: In NPC mode wins add to Unbanked and pay nothing at the finish; CashOut pays once and zeroes; Stop, death and leaving pay the bank.
bank.why: Banked money is a promise; paying twice or never is a real-money-feel bug.

multiplayer.checks: Two players racing from the same spot pass through each other, both stay upright on their path, and each player's NPC race is their own.
multiplayer.why: Bugs that only show with 2+ players are the hardest to catch later.

admin.checks: Admin chat commands work for admins only, change nothing for others, reply only to the sender, and /tp jumps tracks correctly.
admin.why: Admin commands are a security boundary.

roll_anim.checks: Roll animation timing contract (pop, spin, land, hold by rarity, exit, emphasized extra), compact size and panel positions, emphasized roll rules, the auto-roll pause.
roll_anim.why: Rolls must never overlap or desync from the server's roll timer.

upgrades.checks: Upgrade tree: tiles, prices, gates, bonuses, roll interval, turbo and walkspeed tables (pure); UpgradeService.Buy takes Money once and refuses unknown / owned / locked / gated / poor / non-string / too-fast buys without changing anything; a buy changes only the buyer (another player's Money, tiles, BestTrack, TurboCount and badge stay the same, and one player's cooldown never blocks another); the gate uses the real track count; bonuses are ADDED to stat points in Luck, Money and Speed multis; turbo rolls follow TurboCount and the tier; the auto-roll interval and on-foot WalkSpeed follow the tiles; the badge count and save fields are right.
upgrades.why: Money buys permanent power: a double charge, a free tile or a wrong multi breaks the economy.
upgrades.files: Shared/UpgradeTree, Shared/UpgradeConfig, Server/UpgradeService, GachaService, GachaConfig, CarService

workshop.checks: Mechanical Workshop: 7 plots with the spec rects in the spawn floor, never overlapping each other, the hub, the spawn, the StartPad or any track, each open toward the hub; zone and rate maths (Shared/Workshop); WorkshopService gives each player the lowest free plot with their workshop and sign, frees it on leave, an 8th player gets none; standing in your own zone (alive, on foot) earns exactly rate x dt Speed, anywhere else nothing.
workshop.why: Idle Speed must only be earned in your own workshop, decided by the server, and no plot may ever block a road.

track:*.checks: The track's own acceptance spec (written first by test-writer): length, width, min radius, turns, hills, lap time, checkpoint and pad rules, then a driven lap.
track:*.why: Track rules 1-8 in CLAUDE.md; every track goes through /build-track.

ui_client_rendering.checks: Every declared ScreenGui exists and renders on the client.
ui_client_rendering.why: Catches UI that silently failed to load.

ui_inventory.checks: Every button and panel in UiSpec exists; nothing undeclared is clickable.
ui_inventory.why: Keeps UiSpec the single list of what players can press.

ui_layout.checks: No two reachable buttons or panels overlap at any tested viewport, including phone landscape.

ui_hitboxes.checks: Click areas stay inside their parent and close to their visuals.
ui_hitboxes.why: Invisible hitboxes steal clicks from other buttons.

ui_buttons.checks: Each button does exactly what its label says.
ui_buttons.why: Rule: buttons do what they show.

ui_hud.checks: The left HUD shows the server's Speed, Money and Unbanked.
ui_hud.why: Client only displays; it must match leaderstats.

ui_index.checks: The Index panel lists cars, owned state and opens below the Auto Race button.

ui_stats.checks: The Stats panel shows points and allocation and fits its area.

ui_toast.checks: The roll toast sits above the turbo bar and stays shown through panels and HUD clicks (final design).

ui_rolls.checks: The turbo bar fills per roll and shows the TURBO pop on turbo rolls.
ui_rolls.why: Players must see the turbo rhythm.

ui_roll_anim.checks: Compact roll: bare model + '1 in N', about 12% of screen width, phases in order, never hidden.

ui_showcase.checks: The enlarged roll card opens from the toast, stays open on card clicks, closes on the backdrop, AUTO toggle works.
ui_showcase.why: Click-anywhere-to-close must not swallow other clicks.

ui_loser.checks: The loser screen shows after a lost NPC race and goes away after LOSE_SCREEN_SECONDS.
ui_loser.why: Players must know why they were sent back.

ui_billboards.checks: Pad $ text and NPC labels show only within their MaxDistance. The Best Roll Ever pedestal and the two gamepass car pedestals have their Stats billboard (finite MaxDistance from config, label texts, labels inside the billboard, not clickable) and the gamepass Buy prompt text.
ui_billboards.why: Track rule 6, NPC label distance, LEADERBOARD_SPEC 3a and GAMEPASS_CARS_SPEC 5.

ui_panels.checks: Index and Stats panels are mutually exclusive through PanelSwitch.
ui_panels.why: Two panels at once would overlap.

ui_roll_emphasized.checks: An emphasized roll (undiscovered and rarer than the 5th-rarest owned car) gets the longer reveal and the chat announce.
ui_roll_emphasized.why: Rare moments must feel special and be shared.

workshop_offline.checks: Independent oracle checks offline gain = workshop rate x 25% x time capped at eight hours, the same at every stat (owner 2026-10-13: no diminishing term), every configured level, invalid inputs and MAX_STAT.
workshop_offline.why: Offline Speed must be exactly the workshop rate share for the capped time, never more than MAX_STAT allows.

workshop_phase2.checks: Owned nearby alive loaded players can buy only the next level at its configured price. Atomic offline claims persist before credit, cannot replay on reconnect or repeated Load, and failed loads/claims cannot save.
workshop_phase2.why: Protects Money, saved levels and offline rewards from double payment.

rebirth.checks: A rebirth is refused below the level milestone, before the save loaded, after a failed load and while auto racing; an accepted one sets Money AND Speed to 0 and keeps cars, upgrades, workshop level, Level/XP, MoneyEarned and DuelWins. Rebirth Points: RebirthConfig.POINTS_PER_REBIRTH is 1, a rebirth adds exactly that many free StatPoints, GachaService.EarnedPoints = index points + RebirthLevel x per rebirth, a rebirth point can be allocated (StatPoints drops by 1), and the load trim counts the SAVED RebirthLevel so rebirth-funded allocations survive while anything beyond index + rebirth points is still cut. Owner 2026-10-21: the rebirth zeroes BaseSpeed and the shown leaderstats.Speed.
rebirth.why: Design doc: rebirthing resets Money and Speed, and each rebirth gives Rebirth Points for the four stats. A wrong reset destroys or leaks progress; a trim that ignores the rebirth level would cut paid-for allocations on every rejoin.
rebirth.limits: docs/GAME_DESIGN_REQUIREMENTS.md Rebirth system, docs/REBIRTH_SPEC.md Rules (server), docs/SAVE_SPEC.md section 3

daily_login.checks: No daily reward contains Money; every day grants a potion or the guaranteed rare; a claim never changes Money or MoneyEarned and works once per day.
daily_login.why: Design doc: Money comes only from race cash-outs and duplicate car sales.

weather.checks: Schedule: a weather starts exactly every 15 minutes start to start, lasts 3, and an expiry does not move the next start. Five weathers (clear, rain, night, gold, aurora) with exact multipliers, names and icons, picked with equal chance (2000 picks, each share 0.14 to 0.26). Replication, actual roll thresholds, payouts, NPC start speed, event-only car eligibility (none for clear and aurora), and the Describe stat line. Sky: every weather with a sky applies it, holds it and restores the exact baseline; clear changes nothing.
weather.why: Server weather must change gameplay only for its declared duration and eligible cars, on the owner's 15 minute schedule with equal chances, and the design doc says a weather also changes the sky and lighting.

leaderboard.checks: With a fake OrderedDataStore: the four boards (Speed, Money earned, rolls, rarest car) are read highest first and capped at 10, scores are whole numbers, a lower Speed never overwrites the best one, nothing is written for a failed or unloaded save or for a score of 0. The four signs exist in the hub, are anchored and solid, overlap no plot, pad, spawn, marketplace, race platform or track part, and their rows match the board; a broken store raises no error and keeps the last rows, no store shows "No data yet", and there is no remote. The BEST ROLL EVER pedestal: the BestRoll model, its anchored solid Pedestal inside the hub at LeaderboardConfig.BEST_ROLL, clear of every plot, pad, spawn, marketplace, race platform, track part and leaderboard sign, with a Stats billboard (finite distance, labels Title, Odds, Car, Player). After a board read it shows row 1 of the rarest-car board (odds, car name, "by <player>", CarId, an anchored non-colliding Car model on the platform), keeps the same Car model while row 1 is the same car, replaces it when the car changes, shows no car for a score that matches no catalog car, keeps the last row when the store breaks, and shows "No data yet" with no car for an empty or missing store. Owner 2026-10-21: the Speed board scores the shown Speed (base x ShownSpeedMulti).
leaderboard.why: Players compare themselves on these signs; a wrong write could erase a best Speed after a rebirth, and a DataStore outage must never break the server.

duel.checks: Player vs player duels with two fake players on the live route and an injected clock: every refused request (self, save not loaded or failed, not on foot, dead, busy, cooldown), the track list both players unlocked and a rejected out-of-list pick, the pick and invite timeouts, decline, the re-check on accept, leaving before the race, then real duels: both cars held at the picked track's start, released together after the countdown, the first car at the finish wins, a same-step finish goes to the lower time or is a draw, nobody finishing in 180 s is a draw, Stop / leaving / death is a forfeit. After every duel both players are on foot at the walk spawn, the cars are gone, Money, MoneyEarned and Unbanked are unchanged, and only the winner's DuelWins went up; DuelWins is saved and loaded. Both cars stay upright and on the path. The options.Duel run is also driven alone at maximum stat: starts on its track, pays no pad, calls OnFinish once at the finish.
duel.why: A duel must be decided by the server, cost nobody anything and never leave a player stuck in a car, a pending request or a half-started race.
duel.limits: docs/DUEL_SPEC.md, docs/GAME_DESIGN_REQUIREMENTS.md Duels, Shared/DuelConfig, PhysicsTargets.lap.MinUpYStrict, PhysicsTargets.race.MaxPathDeviation

ui_upgrades.checks: Hex tiles, scroll canvas, buyable badge, ownership, gates and prices match server state, and no UpgradePad exists outside the workshop plots (the tree opens only from the HUD Upgrade button); real clicks invoke the purchase remote.
ui_upgrades.why: Players need a readable tree with truthful purchase feedback.

ui_workshop_modal.checks: E prompt, current level, next price, affordability and purchase result; remote receives no client amount.
ui_workshop_modal.why: A workshop upgrade must be owner-controlled and show the actual next cost.

ui_progression_hud.checks: Workshop HUD rate and zone state, upgrade entry and badge match server attributes.
ui_progression_hud.why: Players must see whether their workshop is paying.

ui_offline_welcome.checks: Positive offline credit displays the welcome panel with exact credited Speed and duration; zero credit stays closed.
ui_offline_welcome.why: The welcome panel must report actual persisted rewards.

ui_weather.checks: The weather icon (owner 2026-10-13): the old WeatherBanner is gone; RacerProgression/WeatherIcon is a 44 x 44 TextButton in the bottom-right corner at every tested viewport, always visible, showing the weather's icon (the Clear icon with no weather); its Card is hidden at rest, stays on screen at every viewport, and its Title, Stats and Time match WeatherConfig and the server countdown (Time empty with no weather). Fixtures: Rain, Night Race, Gold Rush, Aurora, no weather, and the Clear weather. Clicks weather_card_open / weather_card_close toggle the Card; the showcase clicks check the icon hides while the roll showcase is open and comes back. With the weather_rain_roll fixture, a roll during Rain shows its odds divided by the roll's luck on both roll cards.
ui_weather.why: Event presentation must agree with server timing and config, the icon must never cover or be covered by other HUD controls, and free event luck must still show in the odds.

ui_roll_odds.checks: A planted roll with a known luck (RollResult's 6th argument) shows 1 in max(1, round(Chance / luck)) on the compact roll and on the enlarged card: luck 2, a rounded case, the 1 in 1 floor, luck 1, no luck sent, and the catch-all car (1 in ?).
ui_roll_odds.why: The odds a player reads must be the odds of that roll, not the car's base odds.

pass_cars.checks: Gamepass cars (Ember Wyvern, Singularity): CarCatalog.Passes() returns both, sorted by Order, each with a whole-number GamepassId, Rollable false and no Chance, and neither is in All() (the Index) or Rollable(); 16,000 seeded rolls at luck 1 to 1e12, with and without weather, never give one. With a fake market: GamepassId 0 is never asked, never owned and never prompts; equip is refused without the pass and accepted with it; a fake purchase sets Pass_<carId> and equips the car; the pedestal prompt equips an owned car and otherwise asks to buy; Apply keeps a saved gamepass car and the ownership check puts the starter back when it is not owned; a failing market raises no error and counts as not owned. A pass car is never in GachaData, never saved in Cars, adds no stat points and does not change the Rarest Car score. The two pedestals (PassCars.Pass_<carId>): smaller than the Best Roll pedestal, either side of it, anchored and solid at PassCarConfig's centres inside the hub, with a Stats billboard (car name, GAMEPASS, finite distance), a Buy prompt (E, instant, car name, Coming soon / Unlock) and a static Car model at CAR_SCALE on top; no footprint overlaps a plot, pad, spawn, marketplace, race platform, track part, leaderboard sign, the Best Roll pedestal or the other pass pedestal.
pass_cars.why: Paid cars must only come from a real purchase: never from a roll, a save edit or a pass id of 0, and a market outage must never break the server or hand out a car.
pass_cars.limits: docs/GAMEPASS_CARS_SPEC.md, docs/GAME_DESIGN_REQUIREMENTS.md Monetization (Gamepass cars), docs/LEADERBOARD_SPEC.md 3a, Shared/PassCarConfig
pass_cars.files: Server/PassCarService, Shared/PassCarConfig, Shared/CarCatalog, Server/GachaService, Shared/SpawnArea, Shared/DraftCarModels

shop_purchases.checks: MonetizationConfig.Products is an array of entries with Id, Name, Description, Section (Potions/Bundle/ServerLuck), whole ProductId >= 0, whole RobuxPrice > 0; the three potion packs grant exactly 5 of LuckIII / MoneyIII / SpeedIII, the bundle 10 of each of the 9 potions, Server Luck 2x/4x/8x have no Grants and ProductId 0; every gamepass has RobuxPrice. ShopService.ProcessReceipt (with made-up ProductIds and a fake save via SetSave): unknown product, id 0, no Grants, player not in the server, DataLoaded false or DataFailed -> NotProcessedYet, nothing granted, no save; a valid receipt grants the exact counts and nothing else, saves once, records the PurchaseId, PurchaseGranted; the same PurchaseId again or one loaded from the save -> PurchaseGranted with no new grant; a failed save -> NotProcessedYet with grants and id rolled back, and a retry grants once; the same PurchaseId while the first still saves -> NotProcessedYet; only the newest 100 ids are kept. Codes (test codes injected into Server/CodeConfig): non-string, empty, blank, over 32 characters, unknown -> 'Invalid code'; not loaded -> 'Data not loaded'; trimmed and case-insensitive, exactly 32 accepted; grants exact potions and never changes Money or Speed; a second request within 2 s -> 'Please wait'; once per player -> 'Already redeemed' (also for a code loaded from the save) while another player can still redeem. Snapshot/Apply round-trip, bad entries skipped, missing = empty; a rebirth keeps both; PlayerData saves Version 9 with Receipts and Codes and loads them back, and a Version 8 record loads with both empty.
shop_purchases.why: Robux purchases must be granted exactly once and only after they are saved, so a crash or retry can never lose or duplicate what a player paid for; codes must give potions once per player and never Money or Speed.
shop_purchases.limits: docs/SHOP_PURCHASES_SPEC.md, docs/GAMEPASS_SHOP_SPEC.md section 2, docs/SAVE_SPEC.md 2a, docs/GAME_DESIGN_REQUIREMENTS.md Monetization (Shop, Codes)

ui_shop.checks: The Shop panel has its sections in order (Featured, Gamepasses, Potions with the Bundle, Server Luck, Codes, Thanks), one card per gamepass car / gamepass / product, prices with thousands separators plus 'Coming soon' for id 0 or 'Owned' for an owned car, a square red X, and stays inside the panel band with no overlaps at every tested viewport. Clicks: Coming soon buttons do nothing; Redeem with a bad code shows the server's reply.
ui_shop.why: docs/GAMEPASS_SHOP_SPEC.md (owner 2026-10-16): the Shop must look like the references and never prompt a purchase for an item without a Roblox id.

ui_market.checks: The Market has the Backpack look: header with a square red X, Trails / Auras / Potions tabs left of a tile grid holding exactly one kind's items, and a detail pane (Name, Rarity, Preview, Price, Description, Action) matching the selected tile. Clicks: tabs switch the grid, a tile updates the detail, BUY calls MarketPurchase with the shown item (intercepted).

environment.checks: Builds the full chain (and the spawn area) away from the play area, runs BiomeDressing.Prune, and checks per track: Biome spec/attribute and theme, Environment folder non-empty with a Gate at the start, every prop anchored and non-colliding/touching/querying, no prop within CLEARANCE of any road, wall, checkpoint, pad or spawn-area part, at most BUDGET parts, two builds identical, lights without shadows, and Lighting / Sky / Atmosphere / Clouds unchanged. Probe parts confirm Prune removes a prop on the road and keeps a far one. Baked meshes: every Shared/BiomeMeshData entry decodes (BiomeMeshCodec) to a valid buffer (length 4 + vc*10 + ic*2, whole triangles, at most 20000 triangles and 60000 vertices, indices < vc, positive Size), has an rbxassetid in BiomeMeshAssets and is returned by BiomeDressing.MeshFor; every built prop with data is a BiomeMesh-tagged model with Mesh attribute and an invisible visual-only MeshBounds at the theme height and mesh proportions, props without data have neither; each track's Ground top is -1 - 0.02 x Number (no z-fighting). Gate sign (owner 2026-10-21): GateSign / GateSignGui faces the oncoming car with labels Biome (upper-case, words split) and RecSpeed = "REC. SPEED " + the HUD format of RaceConfig.StatFor(NPC speed); the recommendation cruises at the NPC speed, is finite on every track and below 10,000 on Track 1.
environment.why: docs/BIOME_DRESSING_SPEC.md Acceptance: scenery is visual only and never blocks or clips the road.
environment.limits: CLEARANCE 8, BUDGET 400 (placeholders in BiomeDressing), gate within 60 studs of Start, 0.05 stud overlap tolerance, CFrame 1e-3, mesh sizes 1e-3, ground top 1e-3
environment.files: Shared/BiomeDressing, Shared/BiomeThemes, Tracks/*, TrackBuilder, SpawnArea, Shared/BiomeMeshData, BiomeMeshCodec, BiomeMeshAssets

car_expansion.checks: The 100 expansion cars: exact ids, rarity counts (8 Secrets), one catch-all, unique chances/orders, chance and speed bands, every model resolves and passes skin size, collision and massless rules, seeded rolls never nil.
car_expansion.why: The 100-car catalog must be valid and safe to roll, display and save.

car_redesign.checks: Every catalog car except starter and ember_wyvern (111) has a redesign; every delivered redesign wins in CarModels with Redesign = true, is MeshParts with a MeshId, non-colliding/non-touch/non-query/massless, fits |x| <= 1.95, |z| <= 3.3, y >= 0, uses only material-group part names (Body/Trim/Accent/Glass/Metal/Light plus an optional number) with all four Wheel_* or none, Light* parts are Neon, Glass* Glass, Metal* Metal, Singularity has a neon-gold Light part, is applied without the catalog Tint, and midnight_kart / golden_racer / rain_runner use their own model.

gifting.checks: Gift flow: invalid recipient/product/self-gift rejected, cooldown, one pending gift per sender, receipt routed to the recorded recipient, exactly-once grant.
gifting.why: Robux gifts must reach the right player once and never be granted from client input.

gift_mailbox.checks: Durable mailbox: offline delivery on next join, atomic profile merge, duplicate receipts and save-failure retries never double-grant, invalid grants (aliases, non-integers) rejected.
gift_mailbox.why: Gifts to players who left must not be lost or duplicated.

ui_backpack_cars.checks: Backpack has four tabs (Misc, Trails, Auras, Cars) without overlap at desktop and phone landscape; Cars shows exactly the owned cars, least rare first, each with its model, name and speed multi; equipped car has a green border; clicking equips.
ui_backpack_cars.why: Owner 2026-10-20: owned cars in the Backpack.

ui_car_icons.checks: Every catalog car has a model template; every Index tile shows its car's own model in a ViewportFrame; undiscovered tiles are black silhouettes.
ui_car_icons.why: No shared fallback icons in the Index.

vehicle_effects.checks: On a fake player's real auto-racing car: Market equip of void_trail builds MarketEffects (Trail=void_trail) with void_trailCore/EdgeL/EdgeR on chassis attachments (non-zero width, FaceCamera false, Enabled) and the Motes/Smoke emitters (Rate > 0); no BasePart added, mass unchanged (1e-6), same run drives the car; over 3 s the chassis moves > 20 studs with every attachment riding on it and up-vector Y >= MinUpYStrict; skin replacement and Stop/Start respawn re-apply it and keep EquippedTrail; unequip clears every effect.
vehicle_effects.why: Cosmetic trails must look right in motion without touching physics, controls or the server-owned equip attributes.
